articles.title: Tata Sons Profit Climbs 22% but Air India Losses Double to ₹22,238 Crore
articles.excerpt: The holding company's standalone net profit rose to ₹31,961 crore in FY26, even as its flagship airline posted a net loss of $2.32 billion and extended its turnaround timeline to a decade.
articles.nri_angle: Tata Group's financial performance directly affects millions of diaspora investors holding shares in listed companies like TCS, Tata Motors and Tata Steel, while Air India's service quality and route network shape the travel experience for NRIs flying to India.

articles.title: Loan Investors Dig In as Credit Fears Sweep the Leveraged Finance Market
articles.excerpt: Fund outflows hit a one-year high, redemption gates are going up at major firms, and lenders are demanding tougher covenants as the $1.2 trillion leveraged loan market enters a defensive phase.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-origin professionals and investors in the U.S. hold indirect exposure to leveraged loans through 401(k) plans and alternative investment allocations, and the gating of redemptions at major funds underscores a liquidity risk often invisible in portfolio statements.

articles.title: Foreign Investors Have Pulled ₹2.87 Lakh Crore From India as AI Trade Reshapes Global Flows
articles.excerpt: Premium valuations, the global AI-chip rotation into Korea and Taiwan, and geopolitical risk have driven the sharpest FPI exodus in years — but domestic institutions are absorbing every rupee.

articles.nri_angle: NRI investors watching Indian market valuations should note that while FPI selling has been relentless, domestic mutual fund inflows have kept markets resilient, fundamentally changing India's equity funding structure.

articles.title: UPI Smashes Monthly Record With 23.66 Billion Transactions in July

articles.title: Muthoot Finance Q1 Profit Jumps 43% as Gold Loan Book Approaches ₹2 Lakh Crore
